fieldNotes.truckGate: Per LoopNet, 7225 Cross County Rd is a 17-door truck terminal with a 3.3-acre rock/gravel fenced yard. The site is fully enclosed; trucks enter via a single internal driveway off Cross County Rd.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth resolvable. The terminal is set well back behind a treeline and Street View cannot see the gate; satellite shows an internal driveway with no booth structure. remoteGs marked true; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: LoopNet building listing for 7225 Cross County Rd specifies 16 dock-high doors + 1 drive-in door (a '17-door truck terminal'). Reported as 10-25 band, dockDoorCount 16.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large rock/dirt yard south of the building holds rows of intermodal containers and trailers (red/green/orange units visible) — a crossdock/drayage drop yard.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unpaved rock yard with ample room to add lanes/bypass at the entry.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~3.3-acre fenced yard per LoopNet plus building footprint and driveway ~4.3 acres total.
